FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
At Precision Accounting Solutions, our core operations focus on providing reliable and compliant accounting and financial services tailored for individual taxpayers and small businesses. We specialize in individual tax preparation, basic bookkeeping, and payroll processing to ensure our clients meet their financial obligations without unnecessary complexities. Our team consists of certified public accountants and trained bookkeepers who maintain rigorous professional standards and undergo regular training to stay updated with applicable tax laws and practices.

We make use of secure, industry-standard accounting software to manage client data and implement strong data security measures to protect sensitive information. Our operations also include quarterly and annual financial reporting, ensuring that our clients have a clear understanding of their financial position. We adhere to strict guidelines and best practices, including maintaining professional liability insurance and conducting regular audits of our accounting practices. Transparency is key in our client relations, and we establish clear, written engagement agreements that detail the scope of services and fees, helping to ensure a trustworthy and efficient working relationship with our clients.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses occurred on 05/10/2023 due to a data breach resulting in unauthorized access to client information, resulting in a loss amount of $5,000. The issue has been resolved with enhanced security measures implemented. Additionally, a claim on 07/15/2022 for $5,000 related to accounting errors due to software malfunction is still under review.
